rice.later_trigger: 2 days after ponded water disappears; avoid soil cracking
rice.note: 100 mm is a maximum standing depth, not the prescribed amount for every irrigation.

wheat.scenario: 10 November sowing; sandy loam or heavier soil
wheat.presowing_exception: Not automatically needed following rice; assess inherited moisture.

implementation: Rules provide prompts; daily water balance produces actual water used. Weather can postpone a scheduled irrigation. Do not hardcode a universal crop litres/kg number.
